column1: # One program's rows of the -db fixtures (see README.md here for the columns and the loader in ../db_search_fixtures.py).

# Rows db.dl.* (line PS, series PR, PS13a): deltablast `-rpsdb tests/db_search/delta/deltatest` against tests/db_search/delta/dbs or a subject set (README.md there); frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 `-num_threads 1`.

# Rows db.dl.* of PS13a fix 1 (review S1, 2026-11-24): query batches (B2/B4), PSSM files and the last PSSM (B2/B3), lower case (B6), queries of X (B5) and without letters (B7); the inputs are those of NCBI 2.17.0 probes in the fix round (q_batch2.faa, q_batch3.faa: more than 10000 letters).

# Rows db.dl.it0m.* and db.dl.hd*.* of PS13a fix 2 (review 2, R2-S1 and R2-S3, 2026-11-24): `-num_iterations 0` with several queries read together (multi.faa), and the databases whose headers NCBI reads with a warning or an error (`tests/db_search/t5/phd_vstr`, `phd_utf8`; queries `t5/hd_q*.faa`, `delta/q_latin.faa`: hd_q1 with a title byte 0xE9), at one and two rounds, with the PSSM files.

# Rows db.dl.pd.clash.* (R4, line RG-KB item 12 / KB-12-1, 2026-11-27): `-parse_deflines` query Bioseq lookups where a reported `-db` subject shares a query Seq-id (`ids/prot_v5` + `pd_clash_q.faa` / `q1c/p_before.faa`, `pdbchain/pdbtwo` + `q_pdb1ab1.faa`): non-letter-reading tables show the query Bioseq as NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 does, while letter-reading tables, outfmt 0, and multi-round PSSM builds keep LOSAT's refusal.

# Rows db.dl.sh.* and db.dl.ql.* (PS13b, 2026-11-27): -show_domain_hits (each query's domain section, the CDD prolog and epilog lines) and -query_loc (ranges in their rows, spilled, and past NCBI's alignment: the rows of PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS approved exception 35 and their oracles db.dl.ql.or.*); inputs in tests/db_search/delta (README.md there); frozen from NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 -num_threads 1.
